description: This PHP class defines a Currency formatting wizard that extends a Number class in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It allows configuring currency display settings such as currency code, symbol placement, spacing, locale, and decimal places, and provides a method to generate the appropriate format string for currency values in spreadsheets.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class for configuring currency number formatting options in PhpSpreadsheet, including currency symbol, position, spacing, locale, and decimal settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize currency format settings, with options for currency code, decimal places, thousands separator, symbol position, spacing, and locale.

methods.name: setCurrencyCode
methods.description: Sets the currency symbol or code used in formatting.

methods.name: setCurrencySymbolPosition
methods.description: Sets whether the currency symbol appears before or after the number.

methods.name: setCurrencySymbolSpacing
methods.description: Sets whether there is a space between the currency symbol and the number.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates and returns the format string based on current settings for use in spreadsheet formatting.
